Eval judge cost fix (#4461)

On 2026-09-26 the Opus 5.5 judge window billed about $48.10 in Console while the eval ledger said $3.24 (about 15x). Each judge call wrote about 132k tokens of Claude Code context as cache_creation.

What burned the money

layerbeforeeffect
Judge invokeclaude -p (full CC session)~132k cache write per call, never read back
Ledger mathinput + output onlycache_write at 1.25x input was invisible
API keyshared ANTHROPIC_API_KEYpaid reruns hit the operator seat

What this PR changes

partafter
1. Judge@anthropic-ai/sdk messages.create, rubric + evidence only
2. Ledgerprices cache_creation + cache_read; fails if metered vs ledger > 20%
3. Key gaterequires ORK_EVALS_API_KEY; refuses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fallback

Files: scripts/lib/eval-cost-ledger.mjs, scripts/lib/eval-judge-sdk.mjs, scripts/rejudge-eval-outputs.mjs, scripts/run-plugin-eval.sh.
